title: RES: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models with Rolling Entropy Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.29066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A diffusion language sampler makes two choices for every position in its denoising window: where the next token comes from, and when the position is committed to the KV cache. Using the entropy-bound sampler in DiffusionGemma, we study two extremes of the second choice. Committing each token as soon as it is accepted removes the chance to revise it, which hurts when the entropy bound is relaxed to trade accuracy for speed. When accepted tokens are frozen, macro accuracy falls from 73% to 20% as the bound is relaxed, while the unfrozen sampler stays near 70%. Committing a whole block at once wastes computation, since tokens converge in a largely left-to-right order and more than half of the window holds already-final tokens by twenty denoising steps. These findings motivate the Rolling Entropy Sampler (RES), which commits a contiguous accepted prefix once it reaches a minimum length and keeps positions farther ahead open to revision. Un

translated_title: RES：利用滚动熵采样加速扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 扩散语言采样器需要为其去噪窗口中的每个位置做出两个选择：下一个词元来自哪里，以及该位置何时被提交到 KV 缓存中。我们利用 DiffusionGemma 中的熵约束采样器，研究了第二个选择的两种极端情况。一旦词元被接受就立即提交，会使其失去被修正的机会，当熵约束被放宽以用准确率换取速度时，这种做法会造成损害：当被接受的词元被冻结时，随着约束的放宽，宏观准确率从 73% 下降到 20%，而不冻结的采样器则保持在 70% 左右。另一方面，一次性提交整个块会浪费计算资源，因为词元在很大程度上是按从左到右的顺序收敛的，并且在二十个去噪步骤内，窗口中超过一半的位置已经持有最终确定的词元。这些发现促成了滚动熵采样器（RES）的提出：该方法在前缀达到最小长度时提交一段连续的已接受前缀，同时保持更靠前的位置开放以便修正。
tldr: 提出滚动熵采样器（RES），通过在达到最小长度后提交连续的已接受前缀、同时保留前方位置的修正空间，兼顾了准确率与计算效率，从而加速扩散语言模型。
en_tdlr: RES, a Rolling Entropy Sampler that accelerates diffusion language models by committing a contiguous accepted prefix once it reaches a minimum length while keeping farther-ahead positions open to revision, balancing accuracy and computation.
